steps.title: Add library mix
steps.instruction: Dispense 5 µL of the 4X rhAmpSeq Library Mix 1 from slot 2, column 1 into each 30 µL sample located in slot 1 on the magnetic module.

steps.title: Add forward primer
steps.instruction: Dispense 2 µL of the 10X rhAmp PCR Panel – Forward Pool from slot 2, column 2 into each sample in slot 1 on the magnetic module.

steps.title: Add reverse primer
steps.instruction: Dispense 2 µL of the 10X rhAmp PCR Panel – Reverse Pool from slot 2, column 2 into each sample in slot 1 on the magnetic module.

steps.title: Signal protocol completion
steps.instruction: Observe the OT‑2 robot lights flashing on and off to indicate the protocol has finished.
